2610.08544.title: How High Is 0.6? Floors, Ceilings, and Headroom in Interpretability Probing
2610.08544.paper_summary: Probes are the workhorse of interpretability. If a model's hidden states predict a variable, the model is said to represent it. But a probe score has no fixed meaning. An $R^2$ of 0.6 may only reflect what the input already gives away, and the same score can mean different things on different data. We propose reading every probe score against two reference points: a floor, what a declared set of simple inputs already predicts, and a ceiling, what the full input can predict. The gap between them, the headroom, is the range in which a probe can show that a model computes something beyond the simple inputs. We prove that headroom vanishes in two ways: the target stops depending on a hidden variable the model must infer, or the input stops revealing it. We test this on transformers trained for in-context meta-analysis, which must infer the hidden heterogeneity between studies to weight them correctly, and where both reference points are known. Under distribution shift, probe scores fall and prediction error rises $12$--$15\times$, yet the model recovers a similar share of the headroom, indicating that the data lost information, not the representation. We then analyze the real models. The single-cell foundation model scGPT encodes biological variability only partially. We also revisit four influential LLM probing studies, which claim that models represent geography, the state of an Othello board, truth, and the demographics of their users. Against a floor computed from the input text alone, some of these claims hold, while others are largely explained by the text itself.
2610.08544.paper_summary_zh: 探測器是可解釋性的主力軍。<lb/>如果一個模型的隱藏狀態預測一個變數，則該模型被認為能夠表示它。<lb/>但是，探測器分數並沒有固定的含義。<lb/>$R^2$ 為 0.6 可能僅反映輸入已經揭示的內容，而相同的分數在不同數據上可以意味著不同的事情。<lb/>我們建議將每個探測器分數與兩個參考點進行比較：一個是底線，即一組簡單輸入已經預測的內容，另一個是上限，即完整輸入可以預測的內容。<lb/>它們之間的差距，即可用空間，是探測器能夠顯示模型計算超出簡單輸入的範圍。<lb/>我們證明可用空間以兩種方式消失：目標停止依賴模型必須推斷的隱藏變數，或者輸入停止揭示它。<lb/>我們在為上下文元分析訓練的Transformer上測試這一點，這些Transformer必須推斷研究之間的隱藏異質性以正確加權，並且兩個參考點都是已知的。<lb/>在分佈轉變下，探測器分數下降，預測誤差上升 $12$--$15\times$，然而模型恢復了類似的可用空間，表明數據失去了信息，而不是表示。<lb/>然後我們分析實際模型。<lb/>單細胞基礎模型 scGPT 只部分編碼生物變異性。<lb/>我們還重新檢視了四項有影響力的 LLM 探測研究，這些研究聲稱模型表示地理、奧賽羅棋盤的狀態、真相以及用戶的人口統計。<lb/>相對於僅從輸入文本計算出的底線，其中一些聲稱成立，而其他則主要由文本本身解釋。
